precedence.when: Any SQLite durability hard gate fails.
No shared-daemon or broker-only candidate satisfies safety, weighted fairness, and cleanup gates.
Shared weighted aging passes every hard gate, meets the 20-agent material benefit, stays within the one-agent regression limit, and meets all operations budgets.
Shared weighted aging passes hard gates and material benefit at 4 or 20 agents, but the one-agent or always-on operations gate fails while the on-demand path passes.
Broker-only passes safety and reclamation, remains within the declared full-daemon throughput and queue bounds, and centralized run ownership adds no unique passing durability or attachment result.
No earlier branch matches; do not relax thresholds after observing results.
